notes.title: Cold fix
notes.content:
What's that? A new update to the most anticipated game ever surely the GOTY?!

* Made it much less likely for balls to get stuck
* If a ball gets stuck then it will dip.
* I should make it not destroy itself if it's the last ball remaining but I'm only realising that while writing these patch notes. This means a colour can actually win...
* TRUE ENDING CONFIRMED?
* Also added a shameless plug to my other games in the menu. My other games are proper games I swear.

notes.title: Super serious much-needed update
notes.content:
Got a cheeky update for you.

Added a hint to tell the "players" that you can open the "settings" by pressing escape on your "keyboard".
This area can be used to view the controls for the "game" and allow for twitch integration setup. If you are weird like that.
